Article text:
Solving Zden's BTCrypto Puzzle Level HALV
Zden announced BTCrypto Puzzle Level HALV , often simply called “Level HALV” or “HALV”, on April 20, 2024. The puzzle consists of a single image with an encouraging description: “Level HALV - my new crypto puzzle to celebrate the fourth Bitcoin Halving. This level is way easier than LVL 5. It shouldn’t take long until it’s solved.” 943 days later (just 7 short of the image’s width and height of 950), it was solved.
After I solved Zden’s BTCrypto Puzzle Level 5 on September 22, Will Adcox and I continued working to solve HALV. Together, we tried a wide range of approaches and directed countless AI agents running state-of-the-art models as they were released. LLMs and the illusion of competence
One thing that I worry about with coding in the age of AI is that the uncritical use of LLMs can make us believe we are
far more competent than we really are. In general, the more expert you become in your field, the better you can judge
what someone (or an LLM) says about it, and conversely, the less you know in a field, the less likely you are to
question what people say about it 1 .
